# Moments DOM fixtures

- `visitor-opus.html` and `visitor-link-card.html` are minimized, sanitized derivatives of the logged-out `https://t.bilibili.com/` feed inspected on 2026-08-02.
- All original text, account identifiers, links, media URLs and engagement counters were replaced before storage.
- `synthetic-video-card.html` is an explicitly synthetic edge fixture based on the separately verified video-title selector.
- Fixtures retain only DOM contracts needed by the future adapter; they are not full page snapshots.
